style: Photorealistic luxury real estate film. Smooth, slow, steady gimbal camera move. Natural light. Keep the architecture exactly as it is: no people, no added furniture, no text, no warping.

shots.move: Slow cinematic push-in toward the front entry, soft clouds drifting overhead.
Slow dolly forward into the two-story great room, rising very slightly.
Slow lateral slide along the kitchen island, gentle parallax.
Slow push toward the covered deck, the fire flickering gently.
Slow rising drift over the backyard toward the evergreen greenbelt.
